purpose: Side-by-side 3D terrain viewer. Visualisation only; never used in F, U, C or P.
caveats: Heights are shown relative to each patch's own median; Earth, Mars and Moon vertical datums are not comparable.
MOLA native pixels (~3.5 x 3.7 km) are coarser than the 2-km lattice, so the Mars patch is smoother than its true surface.
Broad-scale altimetry cannot show rover-scale rocks, slopes or landing hazards.

targets.classification: VISUALISATION ONLY (derived from observed altimetry; not used for F, U, C or P)
targets.dataset: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd v2.0
targets.height_formula: height_m = DN; planetary radius minus GMM3 areoid
targets.resampling: bilinear interpolation of native pixel-center heights to a 2-km local-offset grid; no added detail where native pixels are coarser than 2 km

provenance.window_origin: committed native DN window (raster not cached locally)
